probe.expected:
open Set Function Filter Topology Polynomial Real in
∃ (T : Set ℝ) (S : ℝ → ℕ → ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ); take T = {0}, S = fun _ n => (n : ℝ), and g = fun _ => 0, (∀ x ∈ T, (∃ L : ℝ, Tendsto (S x) atTop (𝓝 L)) ∧
(∀ x ∈ T, Tendsto (S x) atTop (𝓝 (g x))) → ContinuousOn g T) ∧ ¬ (∀ x ∈ T, (∃ L : ℝ, Tendsto (S x) atTop (𝓝 L)) ∧
((∀ x ∈ T, Tendsto (S x) atTop (𝓝 (g x))) → ContinuousOn g T))
probe.proof:
by
  have hn : ∀ L : ℝ, ¬ Tendsto (fun (n : ℕ) => (n : ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 L) := by
    intro L h
    have h₁ : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, L + 1 ≤ (n : ℝ) :=
      tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop.eventually (eventually_ge_atTop (L + 1))
    have h₂ : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, (n : ℝ) < L + 1 :=
      h.eventually (eventually_lt_nhds (lt_add_one L))
    obtain ⟨n, h₁n, h₂n⟩ := (h₁.and h₂).exists
    exact (not_lt_of_ge h₁n) h₂n
  refine ⟨{0}, (fun _ n => (n : ℝ)), (fun _ => 0), ?_⟩
  constructor
  · intro _
    exact continuousOn_const
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := (h 0 (by simp)).1
    exact hn L hL
